pages.title: The little spirit
pages.text: Have you noticed the little spirit on the dismantling table? It loves collecting the strength left in old equipment.$(br2)Give it equipment full of infusion, and it will carefully gather the enhanced strength into a book.
A table that gives old strength a new journey.

pages.title: Attribute book
pages.text: Give the table enhanced equipment with its infusion filled to receive an attribute book. Dismantling consumes the equipment; its original attributes stay behind.$(br2)Place the book and suitable equipment in an anvil to give that strength a new home.

pages.title: Breaking the limit
pages.text: Attack, ranged damage, spell power, armor and toughness can grow beyond their old limits. A breakthrough costs more experience; only strength beyond the old limit is reduced.$(br2)Enhanced glass and other blocks can also lend their strength when worn on the head.
